test_title: PYST 38: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 28 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The elusive moon peeked from behind the clouds, __illuminating the earth with__ its gentle glow.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 (lighting up the earth with)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"illuminating"** means to light up or make something bright and visible, often referring to providing clarity or understanding. (प्रकाश डालना / उजागर करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The streetlights were illuminating the road, making it easy for pedestrians to walk safely.
 
 
 
• The phrase **"lighting up"** is synonymous with "illuminating" and refers to making something brighter by providing light. (प्रकाशित करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The fireworks were lighting up the night sky during the celebration.
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate substitution for the underlined segment is **"lighting up the earth with."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (lighting up the earth with)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Glowing up the earth for** (पृथ्वी को चमकाना): This phrase is grammatically incorrect and does not fit the context of the sentence.

 
 
• **Example:** (N/A – Incorrect usage)
 
 
 
• **Empowering the earth via** (पृथ्वी को सशक्त करना): This phrase implies giving strength or power to the earth, which does not fit the context of the moonlight illuminating the earth.
 
 
• **Example:** The NGO is empowering the community via education and skill development.
 
 
 
• **Encouraging the earth with** (पृथ्वी को प्रोत्साहित करना): This phrase suggests motivation or support, which is not relevant to the context of the moonlight.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher is encouraging the students with positive feedback.
 
 

37:T8d9,

The correct answer is** option 3.**
